verdict.rationale: Docs describe a Logs page where requests can be filtered by model/provider/status, searched by request ID, inspected individually to see routing, and exported as CSV/JSON, plus a Usage section and request logs that capture spend, model usage, and observability metrics tied to requests. This directly matches inspecting logged requests/responses with latency, token counts, and cost attached; missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the UI showing per-request latency and token counts explicitly.
